title: The Locked Library
intro: You wake up on a cold stone floor. Dust drifts in the dim light of a single lamp. You are inside a locked library. In front of you stand a desk, a bookshelf, a painting, a locked drawer and a door secured with a four-digit code. Explore, collect items and find the clues to escape.

desk.name: desk
desk.examine: A heavy oak desk covered in dust. A brass magnifying glass rests on the blotter, and a scrap of paper beside it reads: 'Not all books on the shelf are equal. Look for the four that stand out.'

bookshelf.name: bookshelf
bookshelf.examine: Floor-to-ceiling shelves of dusty volumes. Four red books are arranged differently from the rest, their spines tilted outward.

red_books.name: four red books
red_books.examine: Each red book has a handwritten number inside its front cover. From left to right they read: 3, 1, 4, 2.

painting.name: painting
painting.examine: A stormy seascape with a lighthouse. Faint scratches in the foam of the waves are far too small to read with the naked eye.

magnifying_glass.text: Through the magnifying glass the scratches resolve into four tiny numerals hidden in the foam: 9, 0, 2, 6.

drawer.name: locked drawer
drawer.examine: A small drawer with a four-digit combination lock.
drawer.examine_solved: The drawer is open and its lock hangs loose.

lock.success: The dials click into place and the drawer slides open. Inside lies a small brass key.

door.name: door
door.examine: A heavy oak door. Beside it is a keypad, hidden behind a locked metal plate with a small keyhole.
door.examine_plate_open: A heavy oak door. The metal plate is open, exposing a keypad that waits for a four-digit code.

brass_key.text: The brass key turns in the keyhole and the metal plate swings open, exposing a keypad that waits for a four-digit code.

lock.success: The keypad beeps, the bolts retract and the heavy door swings open. Daylight floods in - you have escaped the library!

magnifying_glass.name: brass magnifying glass
magnifying_glass.description: A brass magnifying glass with a worn wooden handle.

brass_key.name: small brass key
brass_key.description: A small brass key with an ornate bow.

puzzles.drawer_code: Open the drawer with the combination
puzzles.painting_code: Read the hidden numerals on the painting
puzzles.door_plate: Unlock the metal plate beside the door
puzzles.door_code: Enter the exit code on the keypad

hints.text: Maybe start by examining the desk.
There is a magnifying glass on the desk. Try taking it.
Some books on the bookshelf may be worth a closer look.
Examine the books that stand out on the shelf.
The numbers from the red books might fit the lock on the drawer.
Something is inside the open drawer. Try taking it.
The painting hides something too small to see. Is there a tool that could help?
The metal plate by the door has a keyhole. Perhaps use an item on the door.
The keypad is open. Which four numbers have you discovered that you have not used yet?
